create_better_networking.configuration.s: Show the network’s sign upon the HUD
Show the network’s sign upon the clipboard’s glowing display when the network hath no name
create_better_networking.frequency.copie: Network %s hath been copied to thy clipboard
create_better_networking.frequency.contr: Shift-left-click to copy; left-click to paste. To bestow a name upon a network, add a clipboard entry bearing only #network: Link Series.
create_better_networking.frequency.empty: No frequency hath been kept. Shift-left-click a linked block to copy one.
create_better_networking.frequency.inact: That factory gauge panel doth lie idle
create_better_networking.frequency.prote: Thou hast no leave to alter that network
create_better_networking.frequency.same: That block doth already use this frequency
create_better_networking.frequency.clear: Thy clipboard’s network hath been cleared
